meaning: (Qal) to take hold of, seize, take away, pile up, snatch up (coals)

elsewhere.note: God will likewise destroy you forever. He will take you up, and pluck you out of your tent, and root you out of the land of the living.
Can a man scoop fire into his lap, and his clothes not be burned?
He will break it as a potter’s vessel is broken, breaking it in pieces without sparing, so that there won’t be found among the broken pieces a piece good…
